component_inference.insulator_source: preserved adapted_specialist full_plus_tiles predictions; no duplicate inference

material_policy.final_reason: The UK v3 source pages do not provide independent instance-level material evidence; a passing classifier gate remains an unverified diagnostic candidate.

steelwork.target_definition: Visible load-bearing metallic support assembly attached to a distribution pole; excludes conductors, insulator bodies, the pole shaft and isolated small fasteners.
queries: a metal support bracket on an electricity pole.

pole_top.target_definition: A deterministic search region around the elongated pole-box axis endpoint nearest a crossarm prediction.

output_contract.pole_crossarm_insulator: Model detections with raw uncalibrated operating scores and source-model identity.
output_contract.material: Frozen-head diagnostic candidate plus a separate final unknown state; never a fabricated percentage.
output_contract.steelwork: Open-vocabulary structural-metal candidate with composition_verified=false; not a steelwork truth label.
output_contract.pole_top: Derived geometry with score=null; not a trained detector or physical-component claim.
output_contract.references: The 30 v3 analyst boxes and hard-negative roles are unavailable to inference and are not written into model output records.

evaluation: Presentation and evidence-contract diagnostic only. No multi-component accuracy is computed because pole/crossarm, steelwork, pole-top and material truth are absent on this cohort.
claim_boundary: This protocol can create a Keen-style multi-layer review overlay from real model outputs, but it cannot claim Keen-level performance, calibrated confidence, UK material accuracy, verified steel composition or physical pole-top detection.
budget: One inference-only Roihu gputest job after explicit user authorisation. No gradient steps, no threshold/model selection, no use of v3 boxes, and no automatic retry or follow-on tuning.
